title: Microsoft signs $17.4B GPU capacity deal with Nebius

sources.quote: Subject to the satisfaction of the deployment and availability of the GPU Services, the total contract value is about $17.4 billion through 2031.
Microsoft may also acquire additional services and/or capacity under the Agreement, which would increase the total contract value to about $19.4 billion.

explain: Microsoft agreed to pay Nebius about $17.4 billion over five years for dedicated GPU capacity at Nebius's Vineland, New Jersey data center; if Microsoft buys extra capacity the total could reach about $19.4 billion.
